note: Scenarios driven by generated input. They carry a recipe - the recording to cut an approach prefix from, the frame to cut at, a seed, a frame count - and never the input file itself: the seed is what deserves versioning, not the megabytes, and the campaign rebuilds the file before every run so a stale file from an older seed cannot be mistaken for this one. Every cell these move carries coverage_source SCRIPTED, which can reach PARTIAL and never PASS.

scenarios.description: Boo's Haunted Bash approached through the recorded prefix, then driven by seed 1001. Looks for anything the recorded session never touched: star, lottery, battle, fortune, Bowser, block, last five turns.
Toad's Midway Madness through walk.txt's own approach, then seed 2001. w01 has only ever been reached once, by a replay that walked and stopped.
